jobs.occupation: IS Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced 3DEXPERIENCE specialist ready to help shape the future PLM landscape at Grundfos?

At Grundfos, we're advancing our engineering and product development capabilities through the Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform. As our new System Consultant, PLM 3DX, you'll play a key role in further implementing the platform, ensuring a stable, high-performing platform while supporting its continuous development and adoption across the organisation.

What you will be doing

As part of the Tools & Integration Solutions team, you will:

• 
Be the expert who gets things moving, provide second- and third-level support for the 3DEXPERIENCE platform, solve complex technical issues and perform root-cause analysis.

• 
Make a lasting impact on platform reliability by turning recurring problems into improvements that help users work with confidence.

• 
Support and shape the future of PLM and engineering workflows, working closely with Engineering, IT and external partners to bring better ways of working to life.

• 
Develop and maintain best practices, clear documentation and practical guidance that empower users and make everyday work easier.

• 
Be a trusted voice for stakeholders, helping them get more from the platform and spot opportunities to improve how they work.

• 
Help bring platform improvements to life through supporting releases, testing and stabilisation.

What makes you a great fit

We imagine that you have:

• Experience working with the Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform in an engineering or manufacturing environment.

• Experience supporting, operating or administering business-critical PLM solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including incident and root-cause management.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams, business stakeholders and vendors.

• A degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.

• Professional proficiency in English.

It is an advantage if you also have

• Experience with CATIA and engineering design workflows.

• Experience with ENOVIA and broader PLM processes.

• Experience from product development or manufacturing environments.

• Knowledge of digital engineering and product lifecycle management practices.

Why you'll love working here

• Flexible working arrangements and opportunities for hybrid work.

• Annual bonus opportunities, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being.

• Three additional paid volunteering days each year.

• Access to learning and development programmes.

• The opportunity to contribute to the future of engineering systems in a global technology leader.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and abilities.

Join Grundfos. Apply today!

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

jobs.occupation: Business Data Analyst, Falcom, GN Group
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our Commercial Operations team under the Program Management team and help turn commercial data into reliable, actionable insights for the business.

**Built on a proud legacy of more than 155 years of audio and technical solutions, Falcom delivers high-quality tactical communication systems, such as headsets, intercom systems, cables and connectors, sold to military and public safety users worldwide.

The role as Business Data Analyst is for someone who enjoys creating structure by building and maintaining data from HighStage, Excel and other business applications and is not always organized in the same way. You will not be expected to simply maintain existing reports, we are looking for someone who can build the structure behind them, challenge the data when something does not make sense, and continuously improve how we collect and organize information.

**The team you will be joining

**You will be based in our HQ in Ballerup and report to the Head of Program Management. You are expected to work independently, take ownership, and find motivation in contributing to the whole business. For our team to succeed we rely on trust, collaboration, and a positive, solution‑oriented mindset.

The role offers opportunities to grow. Over time, we expect you to take increasing ownership of our programs and sales data and help define how we use data across the business.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will work closely with Program Management, Sales and Operations to:

• Consolidate and analyse large datasets from HighStage, Excel and other business applications.

• Create structured datasets and identify fragmented, inconsistent or incomplete data inputs.

• Translate sales pipeline and program data into useful input for operational planning, forecasting and decision-making.

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies in our data and develop practical ways of improving data quality.

• Develop reporting and dashboards that create transparency across programs, opportunities, demand and deliveries.

• Work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and translate this into meaningful data and reporting.

• Support the development of our data structures as our systems and business processes evolve.

• Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we collect, structure, analyse and use business data.

**What We Are Looking For

**You probably have 2-5 years of relevant experience from a role within business analysis, data analysis, commercial operations, supply chain, or a similar field.

**We Expect That You

**

• Are highly skilled in Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Have strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.

• Can combine data from different sources and turn it into something useful for the business.

• Understand that good analysis requires both understanding the data and understanding the business behind it.

• Can communicate complex information in a simple and understandable way.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Other Requirements For The Role

**Interest in AI is important. Hands-on experience using AI for analysis, automation or business processes is an advantage, but we are equally interested in someone who is curious and motivated to develop these capabilities.

Background check. Please note that all FalCom employees will be subject to a background check and must maintain a clean record throughout employment.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, which is why we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to a potential first interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 27 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate is found, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**FalCom is built on GN Group’s foundation, with 150+ years of innovation, as an established provider of intelligent audio solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, GN delivers technology that enhances hearing and sight. We enable people to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, gamers, and tactical units.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build and own the data pipelines that the rest of the business depends on? Then we have a skilled and ambitious team who would love to meet you!

Continia develops add-on solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 22,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 2,200 reselling partners.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Reporting department. The department is responsible for business intelligence, integrations, and the machine learning and AI that run in production across the company.

You will be joining a small experienced team with different responsibilities on our platform, all owning a part of the setup.

About your role

Your focus will be on building and orchestrating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks.

You will:

• Build, orchestrate and maintain data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks

• Ingest data from a broad range of source systems and land it reliably in our Data Lakehouse

• Write the SQL and Spark transformations that turn raw data into trusted, documented datasets

• Monitor, troubleshoot and improve pipelines already running in production

• Take ownership of data quality, lineage and documentation for the pipelines you build

• Work with the platform around the pipelines, including Unity Catalog, Event Hubs and Service Bus

• Collaborate with the colleagues who build our reporting and ML solutions on top of your data

You will work independently on your own tasks, with close sparring from experienced colleagues.

About you

SQL is your native language. It is the tool you reach for first, and you read, write and reason about it without thinking twice. You also:

• Have hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks or similar pipeline and orchestration tools

• Know Python well enough to read, understand and modify code with confidence. You do not need to write it effortlessly

• Have worked with Spark or are keen to learn it

• Understand what Power BI and message-based technologies such as Service Bus are used for

• Work in a structured way, take ownership of what you build and are eager to learn

• Communicate comfortably in English. Danish is a plus but not a requirement

How we work with AI

Many of us use AI every day, and it is up to each person how much they use it. But we do not vibe-code our way into production. Code that goes live is code we understand, review and stand behind, and it meets our deployment standards like everything else. That is exactly why we need someone who can read and reason about code themselves instead of relying on a tool to do it for them.

What we offer

• Real pipelines in production from early on, with experienced colleagues to spar with

• A modern Azure data platform where you can influence how it develops

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see

The position is full-time with expected start in February. You will be based at our Aalborg office at Stigsborgvej 60, 9400 Nørresundby.

We work in a hybrid setup and are typically in the office three to four days a week, so fully remote work is not possible.

Ready to apply?

Send us your application and CV no later than 1 December. We review applications continuously and will reach out to candidates who match our needs.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a valid residence and/or work permit.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other's thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That's why "It's About Time" is our motto.

jobs.occupation: Digital Service Associate
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy trying out new technology and finding better ways to get things done? We’re looking for a Digital Service Associate to handle customer claims and help us use AI and Automation to make everyday work easier.

You’ll learn our Aftersales processes by working with customer claims from start to finish. As you get to know the work, you’ll look for tasks that AI or automation could help with, whether that’s drafting a reply, finding information, or cutting down on manual steps.

Your key responsibilities

• 
Handle your own customer claims and follow them through to resolution.

• 
Gather and check photos, order details, and product information so you have what you need to assess each claim.

• 
Keep customers informed and work with colleagues to resolve claims promptly.

• 
Keep case records up to date, follow up on missing answers, and ask for help when a case needs to be escalated.

• 
Spot repetitive tasks where AI or automation could save time.

• 
Help build and test AI tools to summarise cases, draft replies, categorise claims, and find information.

• 
Use approved tools, keep customer and company data safe, and check AI-generated work before using it.

• 
Document how new workflows work and share useful templates and tips with the team.

Who are you?

You are motivated by performance and like learning new things and trying out ideas to see what works. You might be looking for your first job or have experience in customer service, administration, or a similar role. You don’t need a particular degree or a long CV. What matters is that you’re keen to learn and willing to take responsibility for your work.

You’re interested in AI and how it can help with everyday tasks. Perhaps you’ve tried an AI assistant, built a simple automation, or taught yourself to use a new tool. Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, Copilot, or Power Automate is a plus, but not a requirement. You can communicate clearly in English and are comfortable following up with customers and colleagues.

You are curious, proactive, organized, and persistent. You keep track of the details and follow up until a task is finished. You’re happy to work through a queue of claims, but you’ll also ask whether there’s a simpler way to do something. For you, a useful tool is one that actually makes the work easier.

What we offer

At Actona Group, you’ll combine customer service, claims handling, and practical AI development. Working with real claims will give you a clear understanding of where the work takes time and where your ideas could help colleagues and customers.

You’ll work closely with the Aftersales team and colleagues in commercial and operational roles. Along the way, you’ll build experience in claims handling, process improvement, AI, and automation, and see how the changes you help introduce work in practice.

The position is based in Tvis, Holstebro.

Recruitment process

Please submit your application and CV via our recruitment system. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

About Actona Group

Actona Group is an international furniture company headquartered in Denmark, operating in more than 90 countries. We develop, source, and sell modern furniture solutions to some of the world's leading retailers and private label customers.

We are on a continuous journey towards becoming a larger, stronger, and more sustainable company. We aim to create continued growth and value-adding services for the benefit of our customers and partners while minimizing our environmental impact.

Facts about Actona Group:

• 
2,500 employees worldwide

• 
Headquarters, showroom, and European distribution centre in Tvis, Denmark

• 
Furniture production and local administration in Lithuania, Poland, and Ukraine

• 
Trading company in China

• 
Part of Lars Larsen Group

jobs.occupation: AI Innovation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by creating impactful AI solutions and thrive on curiosity, collaboration and rapid experimentation, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AI Innovation Engineer to join the IT Development and Data team in Global IT, our central IT organization. You will be part of the team’s AI engineering capability, with a strong focus on rapid experimentation and exploring how AI can solve real business problems. You will work closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts and AI Partners to explore opportunities and quickly test what works.

In this role, your technical creativity and hands-on skills will be key to experiment with ideas, assess their feasibility and potential value and help promising concepts to move forward. Your work may span AI, automation, analytics, data and integration, depending on the problem at hand.

You will be expected to learn quickly, navigate ambiguity and find pragmatic ways to solve operational challenges, taking ideas from initial exploration towards solutions that can create value for the business.

Location Virum

Experience 2 - 5 Years

Department Global IT

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AI Innovation Engineer you’ll be:

• Collaborating with AI Partners, engineering specialists, and business stakeholders to understand challenges, explore workflows, and identify where AI can create meaningful value.

• Rapidly experimenting with, building and testing AI-enabled solutions using approved development tools and platforms, and helping successful ideas mature and scale where relevant.

• Translating business needs into practical technical approaches and assessing feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, security and other relevant risks.

• Connecting models, data, systems and workflows to quickly test ideas, learn from users and iterate based on feedback and observed results.

• Capturing and sharing technical learnings, reusable components and successful approaches, and communicating technical options and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audience.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and practical, with the confidence to explore possibilities while staying focused on solving a real user or business problem.

• Comfortable moving between conversations with stakeholders and hands-on development, and able to turn ambiguity into a testable next step.

• Collaborative and respectful of different professional, individual, and cultural perspectives.

• Open about uncertainty, trade-offs, and risks, and willing to seek input when a decision requires specialist knowledge.

• Motivated by continuous learning, experimentation and sharing knowledge that helps others move faster.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Approximately 2–5 years of experience developing software, automations, analytics, data, or AI-enabled solutions.

• Hands-on experience with Python, APIs, integrations, and data. Knowledge of AI solution patterns (MCP, RAG, tool calling, agentic AI) and platforms such as Azure AI, Power Platform, or Microsoft Fabric is an advantage.

• Solid understanding of AI models, their capabilities and limitations, and how they influence solution design.

• AI-first mindset, using AI-assisted development to rapidly explore, build, test, and refine solutions.

• Experience working directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand problems, explore options and translate needs into practical technical approaches

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 1st December 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to mid-level engineer or/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

**What you will do:

**

• Train state-of-the-art machine learning models

• Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge

• Define and supervise data annotation tasks

• Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings

• Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks

**What you will need:

**

• MSc or PhD in a relevant field

• Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects

• Great coding skills

• Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts

• Ability to examine details closely and critically

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.
The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication
• Networks
• Antennas
• Control systems
• Sound
• Artifical intelligence
• Signal Processing
• Computing
• Quantum technology 
• Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:
• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.
Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirements
Applicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Global Process Owner, Procure to Pay, ERP Transformation
jobs.description:

The job
In this position, you'll work at the forefront of geomagnetic research, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to developing advanced methods for using the geomagnetic field for navigation.

Our expectations of you
We’re seeking someone who: 

• 
has knowledge of Earth's magnetic field and its use in Navigation

• 
is experienced in using MATLAB for scientific programming and data processing

• 
has prior experience with solving Inverse Problems, Kalman Filtering, and algorithms used for Navigation using Earth’s magnetic field

At DTU Space, you’ll be part of a dynamic and supportive research community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of science and technology. Your work will play an integral role in advancing our understanding of geomagnetism and its applications.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

• Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

• Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

• Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

jobs.occupation: Account Manager (B2B) - Full-time
jobs.description:
Are you ambitious, skilled at engaging with businesses, motivated by the prospect of achieving measurable sales results and the opportunity to shape your own success?

About Siite

Siite ApS is a full-service web and marketing agency that helps Danish SMEs with digital solutions that drive visibility, growth and measurable business results. We have a team of more than 35 colleagues and work across our departments in sales, web development, marketing and consultancy.

We are currently looking for an ambitious Account Manager in Copenhagen who is motivated by delivering results, building strong client relationships and developing their career within a company with high ambitions.

Briefly about the role

At Siite, you’re an Account Manager.

This means that your responsibility does not end once the agreement has been signed. You will support the client throughout the entire partnership and act as their commercial sparring partner, getting to know their business, monitoring its development and ensuring that we continue to create value. You are responsible for the entire customer journey – from the initial contact and needs assessment through to advising the client, concluding the agreement, following up and developing the customer relationship.

You will be working both to attract new clients and to develop your existing client portfolio. You will take the initiative in establishing new relationships and identifying business opportunities, whilst our in-house appointment bookers will regularly arrange high-quality meetings for you.

Your day-to-day work will involve a mix of proactive sales activities, client meetings, follow-ups and providing ongoing advice to your own client portfolio. Some meetings will take place online, others at the client’s premises – and at the office, you’ll work closely with both the sales team and our digital specialists.

As part of our ongoing consultancy service, our specialists in marketing, web development and digital solutions are right there to support you. This means you can focus on the customer, understand the business and bring together the right expertise for each individual solution.

The aim is not simply to secure a deal, but to build relationships that develop over time. As an Account Manager, you will become the client’s regular commercial point of contact and support them from the initial discussion throughout the entire partnership.

Your main responsibilities

• Proactive engagement with new and existing B2B customers.

• Needs assessment and advice on Siite’s digital solutions – online and in person.

• Preparing quotations, as well as negotiating and finalising contracts.

• Systematic follow-up on leads and management of your own pipeline and CRM.

• Building and developing strong, long-term customer relationships.

• Close collaboration with our specialists in marketing and web development, with a focus on customer satisfaction and increased sales.

Who are you?

• You have experience in B2B sales, account management or meeting booking.

• Thrives on responsibility, building relationships and clear objectives.

• Works in a structured way and consistently sees your opportunities through to the end.

• I am motivated by attracting new customers and developing existing relationships.

• I am interested in marketing, digital solutions and business development.

• Is curious, persistent and not afraid to pick up the phone.

• Would you like to help set up a new sales office and put your own stamp on it?.

**A workplace with a high level of well-being

**We have high ambitions – both for our customers, our results and the workplace we create together.

In our latest GAIS survey, Siite scored 95 out of 100 for overall well-being, including 94 for management, 94 for colleagues and 98 for looking forward to the next working day. We’re proud of that. For us, good results go hand in hand with an environment where people thrive, develop and are keen to succeed together.

We offer

• A fixed salary and an attractive commission scheme with no cap, which rewards good performance.

• Your own client portfolio, which you will be responsible for building and developing.

• In-house meeting bookers who consistently arrange high-quality meetings.

• A thorough introduction to our solutions, sales process and approach to working with customers.

• Close collaboration with the sales management team and specialists in marketing, web development and digital solutions.

• Freedom with responsibility and the opportunity to shape your own working day.

• An ambitious sales environment where we share experiences, bounce ideas off one another and develop together.

• Genuine opportunities for development – both professionally and commercially, and in line with the organisation’s growth

Send your application and CV to job@siite.dk. Please write briefly about your experience in B2B sales, your approach to building relationships – and why you think you’d be a great fit at Siite. We’re conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so please feel free to send your application today.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Outbound, Team Lead Christian Thorvald Johansen on 22278106 or ctj@siite.dk.

jobs.description:

Would you like to work with financial regulation and compliance while contributing to the development of a growing regulatory services business at Netcompany Banking Services?

As a Business Consultant, you will work with compliance and risk management while supporting legal and governance matters for financial institutions. You will combine your regulatory expertise with an analytical and structured approach to help our customers navigate complex regulatory requirements and strengthen their compliance and risk frameworks.

We are currently expanding our regulatory services offering, where you will play an important role in delivering and further developing our services to financial institutions. Our services within the compliance and risk areas cover the regulatory process from monitoring legislation and assessing compliance risks to annual planning, data-supported compliance reviews and regulatory reporting.

We focus on the use of automation and new technologies to develop efficient and scalable regulatory services. Working closely with colleagues across data and technology, you will contribute to high-quality customer deliveries and the continued development of regulatory Services.

We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

As a Business Consultant, you will support the Head of Regulatory Banking Services in delivering high-quality regulatory services to financial institutions. You will contribute to daily customer deliveries while helping to develop and standardise processes, control frameworks and reporting models.

Prepare and maintain compliance risk assessments and annual compliance plans for financial clients.

Develop control frameworks, control questions and supporting documentation, including reviewing and quality-assuring data and control results.

Prepare compliance review reports, quarterly and annual reports, and follow up on identified risks, observations and recommendations.

Monitor and assess relevant financial regulation and contribute to translating regulatory requirements into control activities, policies, procedures and governance documentation.

Contribute to the development of regulatory services, including supporting risk management activities and collaborating with data and technology specialists to improve and automate processes.

A relevant academic degree, such as law, business law or a related field, combined with around 2–5 years of experience in compliance, financial regulation or similar areas.

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Team Manager, Guest & Host Care (maternity cover)
jobs.description:
Landfolk is growing, and we want to make our support across booking channels even better. We’re looking for a Team Manager as a maternity cover for our international Guest & Host Care team, with a particular focus on the external booking channels we work with, including Airbnb, Booking.com, Holidu, HomeToGo and Vrbo.

What excites us about this role

Great support starts with a team that has the confidence, guidance and tools to help. Your day-to-day work will bring together people and operations. You’ll create the conditions for your team to succeed, help your colleagues grow and ensure guests and hosts receive knowledgeable, personal support, with quality at every step.

You’ll work closely with the other Team Managers to set clear priorities, maintain high service standards and build a supportive, motivated team. You’ll also help shape the workflows that make our collaboration with external booking channels work in practice.

You’ll lead by example in support and turn everyday experience, feedback and data into improvements to our processes, tools and collaboration. You’ll have real influence on how we work, in a tech-driven organisation that actively uses data, automation, agents and AI.

What you’ll actually do

You’ll balance daily support, people management and improvements to how the team works.

Your key responsibilities:

• 
Lead and develop your team members through ongoing guidance, monthly one-to-ones and specific, constructive feedback

• 
Ensure helpful, timely support by email, chat and phone, with clear standards for quality and follow-up

• 
Develop support workflows for external booking channels, so the team can confidently navigate both Landfolk’s processes and those of each platform

• 
Help resolve complex guest and host cases, disputes and compensation requests within agreed guidelines

• 
Plan shifts for our student employees and ensure coverage during holidays, sickness and peak season

• 
Take part in recruitment and creating thoughtful onboarding programmes together with your manager and relevant colleagues

• 
Use data and support insights to improve service quality, response times and workflows

• 
Build a supportive, inclusive team culture with room for learning, ownership and honest feedback

The role calls for flexibility and availability to meet the needs of the team and the business, particularly during peak season(s).

About you

You’re motivated by helping both people and operations succeed. You bring structure to a busy day, set clear priorities and stay calm when a situation needs extra care.

You might be a great fit if you:

• 
Have experience in customer service, support, hospitality or a marketplace business, ideally with previous team leadership or people management responsibilities.

• 
Enjoy helping others develop through practical conversations, coaching and feedback.

• 
Can balance high service standards, efficient operations and your team’s well-being.

• 
Take a structured approach to staffing, follow-up and process improvements.

• 
Are comfortable picking up the phone yourself and handling difficult conversations with guests and hosts.

• 
Are curious about our tech-driven organisation and how data, automation and AI can support great service.

• 
Are fluent in written and spoken English. Additional language skills are a plus, but not a requirement.

Experience with external booking platforms is an advantage. What matters most is your ability to learn new systems and turn complex workflows into a straightforward day-to-day experience for the team.

Curious about Landfolk?

At Landfolk, we believe the most memorable holidays happen in homes that are loved and lived in. We’re united by curiosity and driven by a shared purpose of helping people reconnect with nature, culture and the people they love.

Here’s a chance to make your mark on a fast-growing and purpose-driven scaleup with more than 9,000 handpicked holiday homes in Norway, Sweden, Germany, Italy, France, Spain and Denmark.

With us, you’ll:

• 
Learn and grow with more than 100 talented colleagues across tech, commercial, customer care, and creative teams

• 
Be trusted, take ownership and let curiosity guide your work and development

• 
Work in a welcoming, open-minded atmosphere where teamwork and laughs come naturally

• 
Explore how AI can support your work, experiment with your team, and share what you learn

• 
Enjoy flexible working hours, a beautiful office in Aarhus and plenty of moments to come together

• 
Join trips to beautiful holiday homes

Together we’ve already accomplished pretty impressive results, and we’re nowhere near done. Read more about Landfolk

Ready to join us?

Your CV doesn’t have to tick every box. We’re interested in how you think, the questions you ask, and the ideas you’re excited to explore.

Send us your CV and a few words about why you’d like to join the team. Include your answers in a short cover letter and send it along with your CV.

We review applications and interview candidates on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as you’re ready, and no later than 30 November 2026.

A few tips before you apply

We look forward to hearing from you.
